[Intro]
[D]
[D/C#]
[D/C]
[G/B]
[Gm]
[D]  [Dmaj9/C#]
[G/B]
[D]
[G6/A]  [A7sus4]

[Verse 1]
[D]They sat together in
the park
[D/C#]As the evening sky
grew dark
[D/C]She looked at him and he felt a
spark
[G/B]Tingle to his bones
[Gm]'Twas then he felt alone
And
[D]wished that [Dmaj9/C#]he'd gone straight
[G/B]And
[D]watched out for a
[G6/A]simple twist of [A7sus4]fate
[D]

[Verse 2]
[D]They walked along by the old
canal
[D/C#]A little confused, I remem-
ber well
[D/C]And stopped into a strange
hotel With a
[G/B]neon burnin' bright
He
[Gm]felt the heat of the night
Hit
[D]him [Dmaj9/C#]like a freight
[G/B]train
[D]Moving with a
[G6/A]simple twist of [A7sus4]fate
[D]

[Verse 3]
[D]A saxophone someplace far-
off played
[D/C#]As she was walkin' on by the ar-
cade As the light
[D/C]bust through a beatup
shade Where
[G/B]he was waking up
She dropped a
[Gm]coin into the cup
Of a
[D]blind man [Dmaj9/C#]at the gate
[G/B]And
[D]forgot about a
[G6/A]simple twist of [A7sus4]fate
[D]

[Solo]
[D]
[D/C#]
[D/C]
[G/B]
[Gm]
[D]  [Dmaj9/C#]
[G/B]
[D]
[G6/A]  [A7sus4]
[D]

[Verse 4]
[D]He woke up, the room
was bare
[D/C#]He didn't see her anywhere
[D/C]He told himself he didn't
care Pushed the
[G/B]window open wide
Felt an
[Gm]emptiness inside
To which he just
[D]could [Dmaj9/C#]not relate
[G/B]
[D]Brought on by a
[G6/A]simple twist of [A7sus4]fate
[D]

[Verse 5]
[D]He hears the ticking of
the clocks
[D/C#]And walks along with a par-
rot that talks
[D/C]Hunts her down by the wa-
terfront docks Where the
[G/B]sailors all come in
Maybe she'll
[Gm]pick him out again
How
[D]long [Dmaj9/C#]must he wait?
[G/B]One more
[D]time, for a
[G6/A]simple twist of [A7sus4]fate
[D]

[Verse 6]
[D]People tell me
it's a sin
[D/C#]To know and feel too
much within
[D/C]I still believe she
was my twin
[G/B]But I lost the ring
[Gm]She was born in spring
But
[D]I was [Dmaj9/C#]born too late
[G/B]
[D]Blame it on a
[G6/A]simple twist of [A7sus4]fate
[D]

[Outro]
[D]
[D/C#]
[D/C]
[G/B]
[Gm]
[D]  [Dmaj9/C#]
[G/B]
[D]

title: Simple Twist Of Fate
tuning: D A D F# A D
